<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "ISSET:", $name, ";";
        return false;
    }
    public function __get($name) {
        echo "BAD-GET;";
        return 0;
    }
};
echo empty($o->missing) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";

<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "ISSET:", $name, ";";
        return true;
    }
    public function __get($name) {
        echo "GET:", $name, ";";
        return 7;
    }
};
echo empty($o->missing) ? "BAD;" : "NONEMPTY;";

<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "ISSET:", $name, ";";
        return $name === "yes";
    }
};
echo empty($o->no) ? "NO-EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($o->yes) ? "YES-EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
